scope: pre-CAD structural review; stage-sized delivery workflow and enclosure handoff, stopping before 3D model modification

source.archive_name: 黄山派适配模型（watch表带版本）【个人制作】.zip

reference_geometry.precision_note: fitted triangle-mesh reference coordinates; not manufacturing tolerance or physical PCB dimensions

outer_shell_cover_locators.roles: matching outer locating pockets and cover bosses; not four full screw holes

cover_internal_hole_posts.role: coplanar annular top surfaces exist; whether these support PCB, surround or replace actual standoffs is unknown

reference_geometry.orientation_hint: photo has wide standoff row toward antenna and narrow row toward CN3; visually consistent with model +Y wide row and -Y narrow row, but no photo-to-mm registration

primary_spot_checks.method: verify source SHA256; count independent raw mesh vertices on selected ring/arc radius and Z planes returned by read-only researcher

structural_proposal.status: reviewable pre-CAD proposal, not approved manufacturing dimensions
redesign_next_stage: independent insulated battery tray and load ribs
separate motor mount and wire channels
structural_proposal.load_path_proposed: battery -> independent tray -> rear-housing ribs -> housing rim/fasteners -> front frame; no load through cell to ICs or pins
structural_proposal.first_CAD_candidate: battery and speaker beside one another in plan; motor on separate structural level overlapping speaker in XY where possible
structural_proposal.fallback_CAD_candidate: motor beside speaker with local rear-housing widening; preserve front interfaces without overall scale

comparison.common_assumptions: A=11.32; battery upper 34x21x10; speaker upper 30.2x20.2x7.1; motor nominal diameter10 and height2.7; hb=2 is only user estimate; hs/hv=4.78 conservative electronics reference; zero structural allowances solely for comparison

coplanar_motor.tradeoff: lower bare stack, larger planar housing requirement

separate_motor_level_overlapping_speaker.tradeoff: smaller planar bbox, increased local stack; motor and speaker independently fixed

comparison.excluded: battery packaging and expansion allowance, all mounts/trays/adhesive, part gaps, wire/connector bends, walls, corners, antenna keepout, model posts and physical standoff volumes
comparison.if_standoff_plane_is_intersected: 4.78 reference may be insufficient; use actual standoff/fastener envelope or a verified avoided region and recalculate
comparison.if_tray_stays_on_standoff_top: 18.66 glass-to-standoff plane controls; 2mm local estimate cannot lower it
comparison.rear_extension_formula: delta = max(0, H_required - g0), with g0 = Z_PCB_rear - Z_existing_cover_inner; g0 unknown until assembly registration

CAD_handoff.starting_files: original STL members in their source coordinates, not the separated 3MF print-bed placements
required_first_checks: match actual trapezoid standoff axes and USB/KEY orientation to reference model, preserving actual assembly
establish actual PCB rear and glass front datums; determine role and clearance of internal printed posts versus golden standoffs
place complete battery, speaker, motor and retained pins/fasteners/cables as separate parametric envelopes
compare overlap and widened rear variants; define tray support and loads before choosing depth
check glass/FPC, key release, USB plug access, antenna region, speaker sound path and removable CN3/debug access
after geometry is closed, use offline fit coupons and actual printer-specific slicing before whole-case or wearable trials
measurements_to_close_before_manufacturi: physical standoff row pitches and relevant hole/board outline
highest point across entire battery projection with datum
strap connector section and lock engagement
SPK connector mating and wire bend
CAD_handoff.stop_reason: user-requested pre-3D boundary reached; next meaningful step is 3D assembly registration and model modification, not another scalar thickness calculation
